sourceOfTruth: PR #689 round 5 findings r5-8 and r5-9, story #687 AC2, and the production resolve CLIs. AC5 governs carried r0-4. Red verifier attempt 4 and the canonical cycle-state hash CLI govern contract-hash-field. How-to 10, product engineer, GitHub Projects via gh.

inventory.producer: runCycle recovery in apps/pair-cli/src/commands/run/cycle.ts and wired baseSync; baseSynced selection in resolveState, exposed by each cycle-state.mjs resolve CLI
inputs: Dispatched phase, mode, attempt and expected commit
Actual story HEAD and integration ref
Prior review or stale preparation handoff
representations: Git commit ancestry and reviewed file bytes
consumers: Each cycle, green-fix, implement-phase, red-spec, red-verify and review-phase resolve CLI in both dataset and installed trees
classes: Sibling or descendant with integration base already included
Sibling or descendant with integration base moved
Sibling or descendant on a recorded stale retry
Older recovery memo after a newer review, including a memo candidate still eligible by ancestry
interactions: Ancestry × initial dispatch or stale retry
Recorded base × driver resolve, stage-local resolve and restart
Newer review × replay of recovery record
Each of 12 resolver CLIs × foreign sibling, legitimate descendant and superseding-review replay

inventory.producer: apps/pair-cli/src/commands/run/cycle.ts checkPrepareHead and recoverPrepareHead, combining the typed mismatch from processPark with the beforePrepare refusal
inputs: Expected and actual HEAD or failed HEAD read
Refusal from exhausted recovery budget or custody
Absent recovery hook, missing recovered head or HEAD changed again
representations: Real recover CLI response routed through the production driver
consumers: Cycle driver outcome and packet gate
classes: Spent budget of zero or one consumed round
interactions: Typed mismatch × refusal and no packet
Refusal × phase, group, attempt and mode identity

carriedInventory.producer: Repository package.json quality-gate script and timed tool exit on the finished SHA, recorded in PR #689 Testing
representations: pnpm quality-gate exit and elapsed seconds
classes: Elapsed seconds at or below target, or above target
interactions: Every elapsed value and exit belongs to the finished commit
Each completed run is compared with 300 seconds

transitionMatrix.sourceState: A current prepare next reads its base from persisted authoritative review, prior accepted group output or stale handoff. Its actual worktree HEAD comes from Git. recovery.json is run-scoped and the resolution code reads it again on restart.
transitionMatrix.eventIdentity: Automatic stale recovery for the due prepare, preserving run/story, phase/group, attempt, mode and the original expected commit. The tested candidate is the Git commit proposed by base-sync.
transitionMatrix.predecessorEvidence: The active expected commit must exist and be an ancestor of the candidate. Review and custody remain authoritative. No memo alone introduces a preparation or authorizes closure.
transitionMatrix.acceptedTransition: The matched case carries the review base with no recovery. A legitimate recovered descendant can be recorded as baseSynced and used by both resolvers and the packet. The current next retains every other preparation field.
transitionMatrix.forbiddenTransition: Sibling and foreign evidence cannot substitute the active reviewed base. A live refused mismatch parks with the typed reason and heads, appending any applicable refusal. A foreign memo on read leaves the authoritative base in place.
transitionMatrix.immutability: Review bytes, findings, sealed ancestry and the prior budget history retain their identity. Do not replace a newer reviewed base with an older recovery memo. A spent recovery leaves the ledger and Git unchanged. Resolver reads leave recovery.json byte-identical for each of the 12 CLI copies.
transitionMatrix.terminalPreconditions: Recovery cannot approve, validate, seal, discharge findings or merge. No review keeps PR-entry verification due. Missing authorization leaves the current hold. Custody retains its own guard.
transitionMatrix.metricEffects: Valid recovery uses one process round in the budget, no-sync uses zero, and spending is refused at the budget bound. Neither a memo nor a parked stage spends a finding repair or records stage completion.

families.regressionRiskLedger: The dispatch names no active regression risk or rewind. The changed transition makes no finding, approval or regression-ledger mutation.
